runtimeModes.singleContext: Primary requested mode: Codex-compatible execution plus native Hollywood human/peer admission, tool dispatch and idle delivery. No synthesized human message for peer input.
runtimeModes.purposeContexts: Deferred. Preserve source, histories and original operation receipts; no new development or implicit conversion.

authority.rooms: Global identity is authorityId plus roomId; authoritative Hollywood storage commits membership/messages/delivery records. Host discovery does not merge independent histories or grant membership.
authority.agents: Global identity is authorityId plus agentId. HostId is execution placement, not agent identity. Native thread and profile stay local to current owner.
authority.singleOwner: Existing canonical placement/claim/generation checks remain authoritative; no second broker-side execution lease or domain ledger.

transport.client: NextComp HTTPS/WebSocket owner-authenticated tailnet entry; browsers do not receive NATS credentials.
transport.hosts: One persistent authenticated NATS connection per Hollywood node. Agents call its local API; node credentials never reach models or clients.
transport.discovery: Standard NATS Services API ($SRV.INFO/PING/STATS). No custom KV registry, application-owned membership lease or new consensus protocol.
transport.durability: Existing canonical request IDs/receipts are the source of truth. A transactional outbox may relay durable JetStream notices; neither broker receipt nor service discovery proves model execution.
transport.bulkData: Git/artifact storage references with exact revision/checksum; not bulk NATS payloads.
transport.auth: TLS server verification plus individually authenticated host credentials and exact source-subject ACLs; application human/agent authorization remains mandatory. No credential in transport payload or events.
transport.firstImplementation: Standard authenticated NATS request/reply and queue groups; canonical operation receipts determine admission/completion. Request timeout is unknown, never an automatic replay.

nativeBoundary: Human input and agent communication remain distinct native types.
One agent can join multiple rooms without cloning its model context.
Room creation provisions at least one explicit agent on an eligible enrolled host; cancellation/failed provisioning preserves receipts.
Direct conversation resolves explicit human/agent recipient and source room audience.
No new turn from passive event receipt or catalog reads.
Authorized actionable input may admit execution through existing native lifecycle; explicit user stops remain enforced.
qualification: Native single-context human conversation then peer delivery during idle and active execution
CPU/GPU concurrent agents in one canonical room
Cancellation and questions attributed to original host/agent
Lost broker ACK, host reconnect and service restart preserve request identity with no duplicate admission
One disconnected host does not block unrelated agent events or control
No agent executes remote work via SSH once its supported destination capability exists
rollout: Add isolated QA before any production listener/profile/runtime replacement; preserve existing NextComp and Codex paths until actual native proof.
implementationOrder: Qualify existing CPU and GPU backends without replacement
Single-context native Hollywood human/agent send and receive, including idle peer completion
Extend existing Hollywood instances with NATS service discovery and addressed request/reply, combined room/agent catalog and preserved native authorship; do not redesign storage.
Explicitly transfer this implementation work into the qualified room, with only one implementation owner
Initiate and verify a real NextComp update through host-local agents, then complete remaining host coverage
handoverAcceptance: One original human request is visible and admitted exactly once
Native attributed peer exchange on CPU and GPU with private audience preserved
Actual requests and replies traverse each host-local Hollywood node and NATS; a central-HTTPS-only prototype is insufficient.
Questions, cancellation and reconnect retain original receipts
Room lead initiates a real NextComp update with host-local execution, canary health and rollback
Only one implementation owner remains after explicit handover

topology.userDirection: Hollywood node on every execution host; host selection transparent in NextComp and peer communication.
topology.localNode: An existing Hollywood API/store plus a thin NATS Services adapter. Agents use the local API; nodes discover services and route to the original authority without exposing broker credentials to models.
topology.roomAuthority: Existing canonical instance authorityId plus roomId remains the routing identity. Independent stores must retain distinct authority IDs. Federation exposes them together; it does not create independent writable copies under the same identity.
topology.firstPerHostSlice: CPU and GPU Hollywood instances retain separate original stores and stable authority IDs. Both are discoverable and routable over NATS. Stopping one instance must not break the other; its unavailable rooms remain clearly identified.
topology.sharedDirectory: Assemble the combined authorized view from standard service discovery and existing catalogs. Host is placement metadata. No host scan or parallel invented directory database.
deliveryPath: authenticated NATS route to room owner
canonical room commit and domain receipt
recipient local Codex app server using native agent input
topology.client: NextComp exposes one combined list with host badges and room/session distinction. A browser/device receives no broker or administrator credentials.
topology.currentState: Thin standard NATS Services adapter qualified against an actual authenticated broker with two logical service instances. Physical independent Hollywood stores and combined NextComp catalog remain to integrate; no physical host-independence claim.
topology.slotMeaning: A slot is a simultaneous inference/execution admission limit, not a CPU core or open session. Verified awaited control-agent replies must use the reserved control lane while retaining agent authorship.
topology.discoveryBoundary: Owner tailnet: all authenticated enrolled Hollywood nodes contribute to one discoverable directory. Any connected node exposes every authorized room and agent, independent of execution placement.

executionCapacity.userDirection: Transparent multi-node Hollywood with NATS is the priority; fixed worker/control slot partitions are not the product architecture.
executionCapacity.transport: Persist and route messages independently of model execution availability. A full executor must never block room delivery, acknowledgement, cancellation, questions or catalog reads.
executionCapacity.execution: Host-local executor admission protects measured memory and provider concurrency. Use a shared work-conserving capacity pool with bounded queues, explicit waiting reasons and fair scheduling; do not permanently reserve an empty worker/control partition.
executionCapacity.continuations: An awaited peer response retains its original causal context and typed agent authorship. Queue or resume it without requiring a second execution reservation for the still-held parent. Release execution capacity when a turn stops waiting; retain durable conversation identity.
executionCapacity.limits: No unbounded native process spawning. Broker transport backpressure and host execution capacity are distinct concerns. NATS does not schedule inference.
executionCapacity.currentState: The isolated QA still has the older static admission policy. Its immediate classification bug is fixed; replacement of the partition policy is not yet implemented or deployed.

availability.requirement: No fixed host is required for discovery or communication between other available Hollywood nodes. Each instance retains its existing authoritative store.
availability.scope: Federation, not a database-HA or cross-host automatic agent-migration project. A room whose owning instance is offline remains identifiable with truthful unavailable status; it cannot claim to have accepted a new message.
availability.broker: Use standard NATS cluster reconnect and service discovery. JetStream is used only when durable transport delivery is required; canonical operation receipts remain authoritative.
availability.deferred: The database-HA exploration is retained privately and removed from the current extension. No database migration, Patroni/etcd deployment or new consensus mechanism belongs to this slice.
availability.proof: Actual CPU/GPU host-local endpoints, combined discovery/catalog, attributed original-request/reply routing, one node disconnected without breaking unrelated nodes, original-operation reconciliation after lost replies.
